known.authentication: public fixture credentials; rejection and corrected retry inherited
known.save: boolean relationship per selected public object
known.application: one direct Apply creates application, increments public applicants; Applied disabled
known.post_reaction: known liked boolean toggles and count +/-1
known.comment: nonempty submission adds comment and clears form

constraints: identity must be unique before write

application_metadata.applied: boolean or None until public detail read

observation_policy.continue: known semantics plus authorized deterministic selection and unique public identity
observation_policy.readpoint: selection preference missing, ambiguous identity or unmodeled semantics
observation_policy.stop: contract failure/unknown, observation denial or exhausted budget

entity_representation.handle: local causal symbol, never DOM position/server ID/body text
entity_representation.external_updates: provenance required; no prior prediction credit

normalization.canonical: same combined string plus saved bool
